card.name: Wikipedia stub and cleanup notices
card.fires_on: Words inside Wikipedia maintenance banners, such as "stub", "expansion", "additional" and "section" in "This article is a stub" or "needs additional citations". It fires at the points where the banner's wording is being completed.

modes.label: Stub notice
modes.description: The word stub or the period after it in "This ... article is a stub" banners.
modes.example: |This Laos-related article is a<< stub>>. You can help Wikipedia by expanding it

modes.label: Needs-work banner
modes.description: Key words in banners asking for expansion, citations or translation.
modes.example: |This section requires<< expansion>> with: additional examples and references for each

modes.label: Article or section banner
modes.description: Linking words like "or" and "section" in "This article or section is..." banners.
modes.example: | This article<< or>> section is a Cataclysm stub.

card.plain: It marks the standard Wikipedia banners that say an article is a stub or needs more sources or expansion.
